# CryptoViz - Proposed New GitHub Issues

This document contains 20 new issue ideas that complement the existing
backlog.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 1. \[FEATURE\] Build a Dedicated Cipher Visualizers Hub

### Description

Create a Visualizers page with dedicated routes for every cipher
visualizer, filters, search, categories and links to docs/playground.

### Acceptance Criteria

-   Well documented
-   Responsive UI
-   Integrated with existing navigation
-   Tested before submission

------------------------------------------------------------------------
